detail: Native runner exists (llama.cpp b9840, AppleClang ARM64, Metal-capable) but no same-model native weights are on disk: ollama has only qwen2.5-coder:7b, no GGUF of Gemma 4 E2B / Gemma 3n E2B anywhere local, and the www/gemma-4-E2B-it-web.litertlm bundle is a LiteRT pack that llama.cpp cannot load. A same-model native-vs-web ratio needs a multi-GB GGUF download, which the loop forbids without explicit human go. No synthetic ratio written; no out/native-ratio.json created.

work_note.goal: M2 Max native vs web tok/s on the same model and the same two prompts the web harness uses
commands: node timing.mjs bare  # web side: reuse committed prompts; compare warm steady-state tok/s
record both provenances + manifest_sha256 into out/native-ratio.json
work_note.prompts: reuse timing.html cold/warm prompts verbatim (count one-to-thirty / thirty-to-one) for comparability
work_note.caveat: quantization parity matters: web bundle is the shipped LiteRT quant; pick the closest GGUF quant and note the mismatch rather than claiming equality
